semiconductor_relevance: Medium — INNODIS provides specialized components and flow control systems crucial for semiconductor and LCD equipment.
summary: INNODIS manufactures specialized components and flow control systems, including valves, meters, and mass flow controllers, for semiconductor and LCD equipment. The company focuses on engineering plastics and the production of parts that support the operation and maintenance of semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
capabilities: Flow control components such as valves, meters, and gauges
